text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The space is modern and full of purpose, its clean lines and glass promising transparency and innovation. As I read "R+D" and sense the hum of ideas and technology, I am reminded of the persistent quest for understanding and progress. Here, I am surrounded by evidence of human intellect striving to connect, reflect, and create in ever-evolving ways. It is invigorating to stand at the intersection of discovery and contemplation.
